observations.says: the office door was locked and its lock not forced
the door has two keys: the Captain's and the pilot's
the Captain was at Marlow from six on Sunday until nine on Monday
the pilot was without his key from four on Sunday: he had lent it to Finch
Finch had the pilot's key in his hand on the quay at eight on Sunday night
Finch was on the quay by the office steps at eight on Sunday night
Finch said he never stirred out that night, and that cannot stand
